concept: Egress-only Internet Gateway: outbound IPv6 without inbound
tests: Knowing the IPv6 equivalent of NAT for outbound traffic from a private subnet.
expected: Egress-only Internet Gateway — stateful outbound IPv6 connections, inbound is blocked. Triggers: "IPv6", "outbound-only", "without allowing inbound".
why_not: NAT Gateway and NAT instance work with IPv4 only; a regular IGW with an IPv6 route gives bidirectional access and exposes instances.
